post.caption:
Coal is stored sunlight from around 300 million years ago, and it solved Britain's deforestation problem by holding far more energy per kilogram than wood. But the deeper the mines went, the more they flooded, and you cannot mine a flooded shaft. So there was a fortune waiting for anyone who could pump water without muscle. The steam engine was built for drainage. Everything else it did came afterwards.
